beats.speech: Stop saying very. Very sad, very angry, very scared: using very all the time makes your English sound flat. In this video you'll learn thirty more words to use instead, each one with a picture and an example. Let's start right away.
Part 1. Stop saying very sad. Try these five words instead.

card.headline: Miserable
card.meaning: very unhappy or uncomfortable
card.example: He felt miserable after losing his job.

beats.speech: Miserable. It means very unhappy or uncomfortable. He felt miserable after losing his job.

card.headline: Heartbroken
card.meaning: extremely sad because of love or loss
card.example: She was heartbroken when her dog died.

beats.speech: Heartbroken. It means extremely sad because of love or loss. She was heartbroken when her dog died.

card.headline: Devastated
card.meaning: very shocked and sad
card.example: They were devastated by the news.

beats.speech: Devastated. It means very shocked and sad. They were devastated by the news.

card.headline: Gloomy
card.meaning: sad and without hope
card.example: He felt gloomy on a rainy Monday morning.

beats.speech: Gloomy. It means sad and without hope. He felt gloomy on a rainy Monday morning.

card.headline: Down in the dumps
card.meaning: sad and without energy (informal)
card.example: I've been down in the dumps all week.

beats.speech: Down in the dumps. It means sad and without energy. I've been down in the dumps all week. This one is informal.

card.headline: Which word fits?
card.question: When her dog died, she was ___.
card.answer: When her dog died, she was heartbroken.

beats.speech: Which word fits? When her dog died, she was blank. Heartbroken or gorgeous? | When her dog died, she was heartbroken.

card.headline: Which word fits?
card.question: The whole town was ___ by the news.
card.answer: The whole town was devastated by the news.

beats.speech: Which word fits? The whole town was blank by the news. Devastated or exquisite? | The whole town was devastated by the news.

card.headline: Repeat after me
card.sentences:
He felt miserable after losing his job.
She was heartbroken when her dog died.
They were devastated by the news.
He felt gloomy on a rainy Monday morning.
I've been down in the dumps all week.

beats.speech: Now say them out loud with me. | He felt miserable after losing his job. | She was heartbroken when her dog died. | They were devastated by the news. | He felt gloomy on a rainy Monday morning. | I've been down in the dumps all week.
